properties.name: Jamuna (Brahmaputra) reach upstream of Chilmari, Kurigram district (12 km)
properties.rationale: Chosen after Sentinel-2 Feb-Mar 2025 vs Feb-Mar 2026 reconnaissance of Kurigram and Sirajganj boxes: clear channel-connected vegetation-to-sand/water loss on the east (left) outer bank at ~25.63-25.70N (about 60 ha in 30 m recon), no tributary confluence inside the AOI, both outer banks inside the AOI, R114/R150 Sentinel-1 coverage. Sirajganj alternative (Kazipur) showed mainly protected west bank with little outer-bank loss; Kurigram south window lies next to the Teesta confluence. Selection did not use the SAR data or the 2025 SAR results.
